name: Choules 2024 enfortumab vedotin ADC PBPK-DDI scenarios
description: Exact table anchors and source-limited reduced ODE endpoint overlays for Choules 2024.

scenarios.name: EV 1.25 mg/kg single dose reduced ODE
scenarios.description: Source-limited concentration-domain reduced ODE for enfortumab vedotin conjugated antibody and unconjugated MMAE. The proprietary Simcyp ADC/full PBPK workspace and virtual population are not public, so paper endpoints are overlaid rather than claiming full PBPK parity.

scenarios.description: Exploratory reduced-ODE scenario calibrated to digitized Choules 2024 paper Simcyp curve samples. This is not the paper fixed-effect Simcyp ADC/PBPK model and does not estimate population/random effects.
